hypothesis: Under the exact-wealth-v2 accounting model, the frozen banded_rm rule earns an out-of-sample Sharpe at or above 0.70 over the benchmark-matched window, net of modelled frictions, on at least 90 clean forward days.

title: Does the corrected banded_rm rule hold up under prospective paper trading?
